title: Bridges Rock Gym
specs: Kids camps include bouldering, slacklining, crate stacking, rope ladder, obstacle courses, day hikes, arts and crafts
Yoga classes include Power Vinyasa, Vinyasa, Vin to Yin, Yin Yoga, Boxing, Pilates Mat, TRX, and Movement
Students must be full-time, at least 14 years old, enrolled in 12+ units for student pricing
Children under 14 require direct adult supervision with a 1:2 adult to child ratio
Yoga and fitness classes are for participants aged 16+
Liability waiver required for all participants; minors' waivers must be signed by a parent or legal guardian
Advance notice required for groups of 10 or more climbers

blurb: Guests climb on bouldering walls, participate in yoga and fitness classes, and attend climbing camps for kids. The gym offers monthly memberships with unlimited access and day passes for casual visits. Special events and group bookings are also available.
extraNote: Parents Night Out sessions with fewer than four registrations will be cancelled with full refund · $5 Friday day pass limited to one per customer per month
